statement: An oracle-command-correction amendment must recompute the frontier receipt metric from the amended sealed bar, so the frontier and doneWhen describe the same required receipt set. Today doneWhen is the authoritative landing requirement and the frontier is a progress projection that silently under-measures: receipt-bar-strengthen updates both, oracle-command-correction updates only doneWhen.

constraints.statement: This is a PROJECTION defect, not a weakened landing gate: doneWhen remains the authoritative landing requirement and was correct throughout. The frontier metric is progress accounting and under-measured. The fix must not change which receipts doneWhen requires.

A negative control must reproduce the observed state exactly: a quest sealed with N receipts, amended by oracle-command-correction to N+k, whose frontier metric still measures N (observed as doneWhen 16 / frontier 11 on replication-target-authority, 2026-08-31). The control reds before the fix and stays green after.

Both amendment kinds that change doneWhen args must leave frontier and doneWhen describing the same required receipt set: receipt-bar-strengthen already does, oracle-command-correction must. Frontiers whose metric names a DIFFERENT probe or receipt file stay untouched.
Process Quest: scripts/solve*, its tests and docs only. No src/ changes.
Proof is a deterministic node:test witness on temp roots, red on HEAD and green after, with the existing amendment kinds as controls that must stay green.
